parameter_semantics: target_object selects the observed red pose used as the acquisition position anchor and phase object; successor_object selects the observed blue pose used as the overlap position anchor; buffer_pose_world is [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] in world metres/wxyz and supplies the intended free-center transport/release anchor. Training binds [-0.181,0,0.02,1,0,0,0]. All three arguments enter causal features, anchor selection, encoding and decoding.
output_semantics: Each slot is [anchor_x,anchor_y,anchor_z,rotvec_x,rotvec_y,rotvec_z,gripper]. The first three values are a target TCP position in metres in the chunk-frozen active anchor: observed red for phase 0 acquisition/initial lift, supplied buffer for phases 1-2 transport/release, and observed blue for phase 3 overlap. rotvec is radians for R_target*R_chunk_tcp^T in world axes. The decoder composes the frozen semantic position anchor and chunk-start TCP orientation, then calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured qpos; gripper sign is native. Slots are t-1..t+14 and slots 1..8 execute.

conversion_check.description: Command FK position is encoded with inverse active-anchor rotation/translation and exactly recomposed; command orientation is encoded by the SO(3) log relative to chunk-start TCP and recomposed by the exponential map. The independent check compares world TCP position, rotation and gripper after shared IK.

cut_relation: Every assigned action in all 12 [0,stop) segments supervises semantic-anchor diffusion and a causal phase target. The 210-230 action overlap with place_blue remains action-supervised from red lowering/release through blue acquisition and initial lift.
